title: Encouraging Production Companies to Use Facilities at Mediapolis@one-north
what_it_is: Encouraging Production Companies to Use Facilities at Mediapolis@one-north

sections.label: Mediapolis and PIXEL Studios facilities
sections.summary: Mediapolis facilities are privately owned and used for media productions, while IMDA's PIXEL Studios provides shared content production facilities and incubates 15 games startups.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Many of the facilities in Mediapolis are privately owned and the owners are promoting the use of their facilities for media productions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: For example, Infinite Studios offers a diverse range of media activities, such as soundstages for filming, visual effects and production services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Several Hollywood films have also used the soundstages in their filming, for example, "Hitman: Agent 47", as well as "Equals", that were both filmed in 2014.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In June this year, Warner Brothers' "Crazy Rich Asians", starring Hollywood and Singaporean actors, utilised Infinite Studios’ facilities as well.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: IMDA launched PIXEL Studios less than a year ago in November 2016 to provide shared content production facilities for online content creators and game developers to experiment with and create innovative digital media content.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In addition, development space is available to incubate promising local games startups and there are currently 15 of them incubated at PIXEL.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: Since the launch of PIXEL Studios, more than 4,200 participants have attended over 150 events.

sections.label: Filming Friendly Zone at one-north
sections.summary: The Singapore Film Commission within IMDA has launched the Filming Friendly Zone at one-north.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Communications and Information (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Communications and Information)
sentences.text: In addition, the Singapore Film Commission within IMDA has launched the Filming Friendly Zone at one-north.
